name: CCA WDCT Corner
description: Step into the WDCT Corner, a vibrant fusion of art, innovation, and timeless wisdom at Aarohan 2026, NIT Durgapur. Embracing this year’s theme, our space becomes a canvas where modern creativity intertwines with ancient traditions.

name: Techmela
description:
"Boot up your brilliance. The next big thing might just be yours."
TECHMELA is innovation in full motion, where imagination turns into action and bold ideas come alive. It is a celebration of creativity, curiosity, and the fearless drive to break boundaries and rewrite what is possible.
Bring your vision to life, showcase your innovations, and win exciting prizes and certificates. Don't just imagine the future. Build it.

name: NAMAN VIDYABHANU
description:
“The right mentor can turn potential into purpose.”

Aarohan 2026 brings you an insightful Guest Speaker Session with Naman Vidya Bhanu, Engineer, Founder & Mentor.
Get ready for an engaging session filled with ideas, experiences, innovation and insights that can inspire you to think beyond the conventional.

name: YASHPAL SINGH MOR
description:
“Leadership is not about the rank you hold, but the impact you create.”
Aarohan 2026 brings you an inspiring Distinguished Guest Session with Ret. Major General Yashpal Singh Mor.

Be there to witness an evening of inspiration and learning at Aarohan 2026.

name: ANUVAMSHI SHETTY
description:
“Great ideas begin with the courage to build something new.”
Aarohan 2026 presents an inspiring Guest Speaker Session with Anuvamshi Shetty, Founder of Lighthouse Capital.
Join us for an engaging conversation on entrepreneurship, leadership, innovation and building impactful ideas from the ground up.

name: AI, IoT & Robotics Innovation Workshop
description:
AI, IoT & ROBOTICS INNOVATION WORKSHOP

A hands-on technical workshop exploring Artificial Intelligence, IoT, Robotics, Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, and IoT Device Forensics through practical learning and real-world applications.

What You'll Gain:
- Hands-on exposure to emerging technologies
- Practical understanding of AI, ML, IoT & Robotics
- Introduction to Cloud Computing and connected systems
- Insights into IoT Device Forensics
- Learn how intelligent and automated systems are designed
- Work with real-world applications and problem-solving approaches
- Interact with technology and explore industry-relevant concepts
- Participation Certificate for all registered participants

Certificate of Participation will be provided to all participants upon successful completion of the workshop.

name: BGMI WARZONE
description: Assemble your squad in BGMI and battle it out to become the champions of NIT Durgapur

name: VALORANT VIRTUAL REALM CARNIVAL
description: Bring your squad, trust your instincts and put everything to be victorious.

name: WEB3 WORKSHOP
description: Step into the decentralized future with Team Aavishkar's Web3 Workshop at Aarohan '26-27! Join us at NIT Durgapur for a hands-on introduction to blockchain and the technologies shaping the new internet. Bring your curiosity and get started!

name: CODE CRACKER
description: Hello Programmers! Codecracker returns to Aarohan. Test your logic and speed against a gauntlet of mind-bending algorithmic challenges. Crush the execution constraints, climb the live leaderboard, and claim ultimate glory!

name: MAZEMERIZE
description: Can you find the way out? Step into MAZEMERIZE, a high-stakes maze where memory meets strategy. You'll get a chance to observe the path, but once inside, every second counts and one wrong move could leave you lost. Think fast and trust your instincts. The maze is waiting—are you ready?

name: SKY N' SPY
description: Take your curiosity to the skies with Sky N' Spy: The Drone Technology Workshop! Join this 2-day, beginner-friendly session to discover exactly how drones work, fly, and are controlled through hands-on experience. Gain practical exposure, earn a certificate, and grab exclusive goodies.

name: GAME OF THRONES
description:
Enter the realm of Game of Throne at Aarohan 2026! In this ultimate test of wit, alliances, and power plays, intellect and strategy crown supremacy. Command your house through challenges of logic and precision to outthink, outmaneuver, and outlast the competition.

Think sharper. Play bolder. Rule fearlessly.

name: INVICTUS
description:
Step into INVICTUS: The Quantum Synergy at Aarohan 2026! Transform abstract ideas into tangible marvels in this ultimate test of engineering excellence across the Chemical, Mechanical, and Civil domains. Push your logic, precision, and creativity to new frontiers and redefine the boundaries of design.

Think sharper. Build stronger. Innovate fearlessly.

name: ROBOLIGA
description:
OVERRIDE the limits. Command the bots.

ROBOLOGIA is here! Outsmart your opponent, master every move and put your skills to the test.

name: DEATH NOTE
description: DEATH NOTE is back! Step into a world where nothing is quite what it seems and every tiny detail could change the story. Read between the lines, question everything, and trust no one—the truth might be hiding right in front of you. The mystery is yours to unfold.

name: Be A Billionaire
description:
“The wait is over. Get ready to step into a world where strategy, decision-making, and smart investments come together.”

In *Be a Billionaire*, every decision matters. With limited resources and countless opportunities, you will have to bid wisely, take calculated risks, and make the right choices to build your empire. The planets are up for grabs, but only those who can think ahead and manage their wealth strategically will rise to the top.

Are you ready to test your strategy, challenge your instincts, and prove that you have what it takes to become the ultimate billionaire?

The game begins now. Make your move wisely.

name: Journo Detective
description:
"Where every story hides a secret, and every clue brings you closer to the truth."

Step into the world of Journo Detective, a thrilling mystery experience where curiosity meets deduction. A story is waiting to be uncovered, but with countless secrets, hidden clues, and conflicting narratives, nothing is ever as it seems.

This isn't just about finding answers — it's about questioning what you see. Follow the clues, expose the lies, connect the fragments, and uncover the story buried beneath layers of deception. Every detail matters, every lead could change everything — can you separate the truth from the illusion?

Follow the clues. Expose the lies. Become the detective.

Journo Detective
Date: 10/10/2026
Time: 2:00 PM onwards
Venue: NAB 011

name: FALL GUYS
description: In-Person challenge inspired by the crazy world of Fall Guys. Real life team based competition.

name: POP IT
description:
What if your hands could do more than you think?
A game where every move matters, every gesture has a purpose, and the screen responds to something you do… but what exactly?

Step in, test your reflexes, and find out if you can *POP IT* before it’s too late. 
Step into the Arena from tomorrow, give it a shot, and discover what’s waiting for you. 
POP IT only at AAROHAN ’26.

name: Equity Rush
description:
Virtual capital. Real instincts. One market. One chance to take the lead.
Welcome to EQUITY RUSH - where the market moves fast, and every decision matters. 
Start with virtual capital. Build your portfolio. Read the trends. And make your move before the market moves against you.
Buy smart. Hold your nerve. Sell at the right moment.

No real money. No room for hesitation. Just strategy, timing, instincts, and the rush of the market.
The market won’t wait for you.
Think you can beat it? Step in and prove it.

name: Image Processing Workshop
description:
Image processing workshop 

An interactive workshop introducing the fundamentals of digital image processing and computer vision using Python and OpenCV. Participants will explore techniques such as image filtering, edge detection, thresholding, contour detection, feature extraction, and object tracking, while building simple real-world applications.

name: Aqua Race
description:
The waters are waiting. The bots are ready. The race begins.
Step into Aqua Race at Aarohan ’26, where engineering meets adrenaline. Take control of your bot and navigate through a challenging water track filled with twists, turns, and obstacles.

It’s not just about speed precision, strategy, and control will decide who takes the lead. One wrong move could cost you the race.
On-spot also allowed 
Think fast. Steer smart. Rule the waves.
Aqua Race awaits.

name: Car Race
description:
BID. BUILD. CONQUER.

The Car Auction at AAROHAN ’26 is here! Bid on legendary classics and performance beasts, manage your budget, outsmart rivals, and build your dream garage.
Will you make the winning bid?

name: FIFA Showdown
description:
Get ready to plug in and power up because the legendary *FIFA Ultimate Showdown* is back and fiercer thran ever at *Aarohan '26!* Storm the virtual pitch to crush your rivals, pull off insane plays, and claim the ultimate campus bragging rights.  
  
Whether you are competing for the grand prize or just looking for an incredible match against friends, this is your moment to shine. No need to worry about gear - controllers will be provided, so just bring your A-game!

name: Perplexity
description:
Think beyond the obvious. Take calculated risks. Challenge your opponents. In Perplexity, knowledge alone isn't enough — the right strategy at the right moment can turn the game around.
A fast-paced team quiz where every question brings a new challenge and every bet could change the scoreboard. Put your knowledge, instincts, and decision-making to the test as you take on opposing teams in a unique battle of questions and strategy.

name: Speed Cubing
description:
One cube. One timer. Endless excitement.

Welcome to Speed Cubing at Aarohan ’26, where every second counts and every move brings you closer to victory. Put your speed, focus, and problem-solving skills to the test as you take on the ultimate challenge of solving the cube against the clock.
Think you can beat the clock?
Step into the arena, scramble up, and let the CUBING BATTLE BEGIN!

name: HackOverflow 10.0
description:
Get ready to push the boundaries of technology at HackOverflow 10.0 , the premier flagship hackathon of Aarohan 26-27! 
Powered by @unstop 
Knowledge partner Uplearn by Upstox 
Sponsered by adaptionlabs.ai 
Step into the arena where your visionary concepts become tangible realities.

name: Foobar CTF
description:
Foobar CTF is back at Aarohan '26-27, organised by the GNU/Linux Users Group, NIT Durgapur. Every edition has been harder than the last, and this one will not go easy on you.

Expect puzzles that test your logic, patience and attention to detail. Some will fall in minutes, others will eat your whole day. Sharp thinking and a calm head will take you further than speed alone.

name: Fantasy Football
description:
Think you can build a championship-winning squad? Bid for the best players, outsmart your competition, and put together a team that can dominate. Every choice matters, so plan your moves carefully and prove your skills as a manager.
Get ready for a battle of strategy and footballing knowledge. Build your dream team and see if you have what it takes to come out on top.
